# Nova UI CSS Framework

> Nova UI is a lightweight, pure CSS visual component framework built with CSS variables (HSL), utility-first layout classes, and fully styled modern components. It uses the custom class prefix `.nl-` and requires no preprocessor or build steps.

## Core Reference Sheet

This reference guides AI assistants in writing correct HTML markup and styling for Nova UI projects.

### Naming Conventions & Prefix
* All framework class names MUST be prefixed with `.nl-` (e.g., `.nl-btn`, `.nl-input`, `.nl-flex`).
* Color modifier suffix uses standard semantic names: `-primary`, `-secondary`, `-success`, `-warning`, `-error` (or `-destructive`), `-info`.
* Size modifiers: `-sm`, `-lg`.

---

### Design System Variables
Override these custom properties in your local `:root` or custom scopes to update styles.

#### 1. Color Variables (Declared as raw HSL values)
* `--background`: Page background (e.g. `0 0% 100%`)
* `--foreground`: Standard text (e.g. `240 10% 3.9%`)
* `--primary`: Accent color (e.g. `240 5.9% 10%`)
* `--primary-foreground`: Text color on primary background
* `--secondary`: Muted background (e.g. `240 4.8% 95.9%`)
* `--success`: Positive outcome state (e.g. `142.1 76.2% 36.3%`)
* `--warning`: Cautionary outcome state (e.g. `38 92% 50%`)
* `--destructive`: Critical/Error outcome state (e.g. `346.8 84.2% 50.2%`)
* `--info`: Informative state (e.g. `212.8 11.5% 21.8%`)
* `--border`: Default divider/border lines
* `--ring`: Highlight/focus indicators ring glow

#### 2. Spacing Scale
Multiples of `0.25rem` (4px):
* `--space-1`: `0.25rem` (4px)
* `--space-2`: `0.5rem` (8px)
* `--space-3`: `0.75rem` (12px)
* `--space-4`: `1rem` (16px)
* `--space-5`: `1.25rem` (20px)
* `--space-6`: `1.5rem` (24px)
* `--space-8`: `2rem` (32px)
* `--space-10`: `2.5rem` (40px)
* Fractional space tokens: `--space-0.5` (2px), `--space-1.5` (6px), `--space-2.5` (10px).

#### 3. Border Radii
* `--radius-sm`: Small corners
* `--radius-md`: Medium corners (default for inputs and buttons)
* `--radius-lg`: Large corners
* `--radius-full`: Circle/pill corners (`9999px`)

---

### Layout & Utility Classes

#### 1. Flexbox & Grid
* `.nl-flex` - Flex container
* `.nl-flex-col` - Vertical flex flow
* `.nl-items-center` - Align items center
* `.nl-justify-between` - Justify content space-between
* `.nl-gap-[space]` - Sets gap spacing (e.g. `.nl-gap-3`)
* `.nl-grid` - Grid container
* `.nl-grid-cols-[1-4]` - Column layout count (e.g., `.nl-grid-cols-3`)
* `.nl-container-[sm|md|lg|xl]` - Locked responsive containers
* `.nl-container-fluid` - Fluid 100% width container with scaling paddings

#### 2. Spacing Utilities
* Margin: `.nl-m-[space]`, `.nl-mt-[space]`, `.nl-mb-[space]`, `.nl-my-[space]`, `.nl-mx-[space]`
* Padding: `.nl-p-[space]`, `.nl-pt-[space]`, `.nl-pb-[space]`, `.nl-py-[space]`, `.nl-px-[space]`
* E.g. `.nl-mt-4`, `.nl-px-6` (use values from spacing scale)

---

### Form Controls (Single-Element Markup)
Form input states MUST NOT use secondary wrapper span classes to draw the graphics. They use direct `appearance: none` styling on the `<input>` element itself.

#### 1. Checkbox
```html
<label class="nl-checkbox-label">
  <input type="checkbox" class="nl-checkbox" checked>
  <span>Accept terms</span>
</label>
```
* Color modifiers: `.nl-checkbox-primary`, `.nl-checkbox-success`, `.nl-checkbox-error`, etc.
* Sizes: `.nl-checkbox-sm`, `.nl-checkbox-lg`.

#### 2. Radio
```html
<div class="nl-radio-group">
  <label class="nl-radio-label">
    <input type="radio" class="nl-radio nl-radio-primary" name="group1" checked>
    <span>Option 1</span>
  </label>
</div>
```
* Row layout: `<div class="nl-radio-group nl-radio-group-row">`
* Colors/Sizes: `.nl-radio-success`, `.nl-radio-sm`, `.nl-radio-lg`.

#### 3. Toggle / Switch
```html
<label class="nl-toggle-label">
  <input type="checkbox" class="nl-toggle nl-toggle-success" checked>
  <span>Enable WiFi</span>
</label>
```
* Colors/Sizes: `.nl-toggle-primary`, `.nl-toggle-error`, `.nl-toggle-sm`, `.nl-toggle-lg`.

#### 4. Select Dropdown
```html
<select class="nl-select nl-select-primary">
  <option value="1">Option A</option>
  <option value="2">Option B</option>
</select>
```

#### 5. Textarea
```html
<textarea class="nl-textarea nl-textarea-error" rows="3" placeholder="Describe..."></textarea>
```

#### 6. Range Input
Uses custom property `--nl-range-fill` to paint active track lengths.
```html
<input type="range" class="nl-range nl-range-primary" min="0" max="100" value="60" style="--nl-range-fill: 60%;" oninput="this.style.setProperty('--nl-range-fill', this.value + '%')">
```

---

### Key Component Library

#### 1. Button
```html
<button class="nl-btn nl-btn-primary">Click me</button>
<a href="#" class="nl-btn nl-btn-outline nl-btn-sm">Outline link</a>
<button class="nl-btn nl-btn-ghost nl-btn-lg" disabled>Disabled ghost</button>
```

#### 2. Card
```html
<div class="nl-card">
  <div class="nl-card-header">
    <h3 class="nl-card-title">Card Title</h3>
    <p class="nl-card-description">Short explanation paragraph.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="nl-card-body">
    Main card block content.
  </div>
  <div class="nl-card-footer">
    <button class="nl-btn">Action</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

#### 3. Badge & Indicator
```html
<!-- Badge -->
<span class="nl-badge nl-badge-success">Active</span>

<!-- Indicator: badge nested in corner of element -->
<div class="nl-indicator-wrapper">
  <span class="nl-indicator nl-indicator-top nl-indicator-right nl-badge nl-badge-error">9+</span>
  <button class="nl-btn">Inbox</button>
</div>
```

#### 4. Tabs (Pure CSS styling, toggle class active on click)
```html
<div class="nl-tabs-list">
  <button class="nl-tab-btn active">Tab 1</button>
  <button class="nl-tab-btn">Tab 2</button>
</div>
```

#### 5. Accordion (Uses sibling grid logic to animate collapse height)
```html
<div class="nl-accordion">
  <input type="checkbox" class="nl-accordion-toggle" id="acc-1">
  <label for="acc-1" class="nl-accordion-header">
    <span>Click to expand</span>
    <svg class="nl-accordion-chevron" ...></svg>
  </label>
  <div class="nl-accordion-body">
    <div class="nl-accordion-content">
      Panel content here...
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

#### 6. Collapse
```html
<div class="nl-collapse">
  <input type="checkbox" class="nl-collapse-toggle" id="col-1">
  <label for="col-1" class="nl-collapse-title nl-collapse-arrow">More Info</label>
  <div class="nl-collapse-content">
    <p>Collapsible details...</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
* Modified headers: Use `.nl-collapse-plus` for +/- toggle visual cues instead of chevrons.

#### 7. Steps Indicator
```html
<ul class="nl-steps">
  <li class="nl-step nl-step-complete">
    <div class="nl-step-marker">✓</div>
    <div class="nl-step-label">Billing</div>
  </li>
  <li class="nl-step nl-step-active">
    <div class="nl-step-marker">2</div>
    <div class="nl-step-label">Shipping</div>
  </li>
  <li class="nl-step nl-step-pending">
    <div class="nl-step-marker">3</div>
    <div class="nl-step-label">Review</div>
  </li>
</ul>
```
* Vertical step flow: `<ul class="nl-steps nl-steps-vertical">`.

#### 8. Keyboard Key (Kbd)
```html
Press <kbd class="nl-kbd nl-kbd-sm">Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd class="nl-kbd nl-kbd-sm">K</kbd> to search.
```

#### 9. Divider
```html
<!-- Line only -->
<div class="nl-divider"></div>

<!-- Text with divider lines on side -->
<div class="nl-divider">OR</div>

<!-- Vertical line divider -->
<div class="nl-flex nl-items-center">
  <span>Left</span>
  <div class="nl-divider-vertical"></div>
  <span>Right</span>
</div>
```

#### 10. Join Element (Remove intermediate borders on children)
```html
<div class="nl-join">
  <input type="text" class="nl-input nl-join-item" placeholder="Search...">
  <button class="nl-btn nl-btn-primary nl-join-item">Go</button>
</div>
```

#### 11. Chat Bubble
```html
<div class="nl-chat nl-chat-start">
  <div class="nl-chat-avatar">
    <img src="avatar.jpg" class="nl-avatar">
  </div>
  <div class="nl-chat-bubble">Hello there!</div>
</div>
<div class="nl-chat nl-chat-end">
  <div class="nl-chat-bubble nl-chat-bubble-primary">Hi! Nice to meet you.</div>
</div>
```

#### 12. Diff (Side-by-side comparison slider)
```html
<div class="nl-diff" style="--diff-position: 50%;">
  <div class="nl-diff-item-1">
    <img src="before.jpg" alt="Before">
  </div>
  <div class="nl-diff-item-2">
    <img src="after.jpg" alt="After">
  </div>
  <div class="nl-diff-resizer"></div>
</div>
```

#### 13. Media Timeline (Visual timeline panel)
```html
<div class="nl-media-timeline">
  <!-- Toolbar -->
  <div class="nl-media-timeline-toolbar">
    <button class="nl-media-timeline-tool-btn">Split</button>
    <div class="nl-media-timeline-timecode">00:01:24:15</div>
  </div>
  
  <!-- Tracks section -->
  <div class="nl-media-timeline-tracks">
    <div class="nl-media-timeline-track">
      <div class="nl-media-timeline-track-header">Video 1</div>
      <div class="nl-media-timeline-track-body">
        <div class="nl-media-timeline-clip nl-media-timeline-clip-video" style="width: 120px; left: 10px;">
          clip1.mp4
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

---

### Core Prompt Guidelines for AI Generators
1. **Never use Tailwind CSS** unless explicitly requested by the user. Use Nova UI's utility classes (`.nl-flex`, `.nl-grid`, `.nl-p-4`, `.nl-gap-3`, etc.).
2. **Never output OS/macOS control dots** (red, yellow, green window actions) inside component code snippets or examples unless explicitly instructed.
3. **Always use native elements** styled directly (like `<input type="checkbox" class="nl-checkbox">`) instead of custom secondary markup overlays (no `.nl-checkbox-box` sibling span).
4. **Theming variables** must always be referenced via `hsl(var(--[variable]))` or HSL overrides (e.g. `color: hsl(var(--primary))`).
